text:
Jordan (CS): HarborSynergy day0 handoff — couple of items popped during smoke tests. Quick sync?
Jordan (CS): 1) Egress from their app subnet hits our proxy but return traffic times out (symptom: SYN/ACK not reaching their instances).
Jordan (CS): 2) KMS envelope decrypt fails when cloud-agent rotates keys (AccessDenied).
Tariq (NetEng): can you drop the vpc/peer ids? I'll peek at TGW attachment and their route propagation.
Jordan (CS): vpc-77b9 and peer-aws-hs-2 posted in the ticket along with tcpdump and security group snapshots.
Tariq (NetEng): initial glance: their route table has static routes to the TGW but propagation off on the attachment. Also saw their NACL denies ephemeral ports for return traffic.
Elena (Security): for KMS, looks like their role's condition restricts usage to a service principal and doesn't include us. Proposing a scoped policy to add kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey with an appropriate condition. Share before they apply.
Elena (Security): suggested policy snippet:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/harbor-cloud-agent"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555666777888:key/key-1234"}]}
```
Sam (Solutions): I can join a 20-min screen-share and walk their infra person through the NACL and TGW settings. Suggest 11:30am ET. I'll capture action items in the enablement doc and ask product for any UX notes.
Jordan (CS): customer is asking for explicit data locality confirmation and wants a one-pager SLA excerpt. Flagging renewal risk as low-medium until legal confirms.
onboard-bot: [provision] privnet: attachment created vpc-77b9 -> peer-aws-hs-2 by tariq-neteng at 4312345682
Tariq (NetEng): toggled propagation on the TGW attachment and adjusted the NACL to allow ephemeral return ports (1024-65535). Running a connectivity test now.
Tariq (NetEng): route table check:
RouteTable: rtb-0d3f
PropagatedRoutes:
 - 172.31.0.0/16 via tgw-1f2e (state: active)
Connectivity test: curl to our proxy succeeded, response latency ~45ms.
Elena (Security): sent policy to their security lead for sign-off and verified CloudTrail is configured to capture KMS:Decrypt events.
Elena (Security): CloudTrail sample: `2026-04-02T09:12:11Z KMS Decrypt keyId=key-1234 principal=arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/harbor-cloud-agent status=AccessDenied` — expecting a Success after role patched.
Sam (Solutions): scheduled enablement 11:30am ET, will record and add a checklist (network, IAM, KMS, logging). Will paste recording link to the ticket.
Jordan (CS): action owners and ETAs:
 - Tariq: verify propagation and NACL posture, post final test results (ETA: 1h)
 - Elena: confirm KMS role updated and CloudTrail shows Decrypt Success (ETA: 3h)
 - Sam: run enablement session and produce enablement checklist + SLA one-pager draft for legal (ETA: 24h)
Jordan (CS): tagging @here — please escalate to eng-sre if any blocker persists after the session. :mag: :white_check_mark:
onboard-bot: [reminder] HarborSynergy enablement recording due in 24h
Tariq (NetEng): propagation stable at 4312345690, connectivity validated from two AZs.
Elena (Security): sec-admin applied role update at 4312345696; CloudTrail now shows `2026-04-02T10:02:03Z KMS Decrypt keyId=key-1234 principal=arn:aws:iam::210987654321:role/harbor-cloud-agent status=Success`.
Jordan (CS): closing day0 tickets, setting renewal risk to "monitor". Sam please post the recording+checklist when ready and I'll follow up with AE for the SLA ask.
Sam (Solutions): will upload notes + recording within the hour. Thanks everyone. :v:
